The Consolidated column removes the intercompany payments between them (Guud Mobiles' Revenue = Guud South Africa's Variable Cost; each subsidiary's Revenue = the matching slice of Guud Mobiles' Variable Cost) so it reflects only the Group's real, external activity. Depreciation, Finance Cost, and Income Tax are broken out as their own lines so this table is ready for entities that carry debt or capital assets.
